api.verify.guidance: Show the case and lane verdicts first, with the raw runner output as secondary evidence.

architecture.decide.guidance: Show the accepted boundary and stack model; use the alternatives artifact when it makes the trade-off easier to review.

backend.generate.guidance: Show the source change or reviewable diff first, followed by conformance and proof records.

backend.plan.guidance: Show the module plan and executable unit table before implementation begins.

business.decide.guidance: Show the decided promise and coverage matrix, with the model as supporting evidence.

business.reconcile.guidance: Show the promise-to-delivery reconciliation and unresolved claim rows.

content.generate.guidance: Render the finished article first; display a generated image when present and link any audio track as secondary output.

data.plan.guidance: Show the seed units with namespace, order, expected state and rollback.

data.seed.guidance: Show the applied, reused or removed records and the namespace-scoped before/after proof.

environment.preflight.guidance: Show the complete readiness table, including every wall and skipped check.

git.publish.guidance: Show the published branch and commit reference, with the publication receipt as evidence.

identity.provision.guidance: Show per-alias reuse, create or repair status and safe sign-in checks; never show credential values.

interface.audit.guidance: Display the audited screenshot first, then the verdict and finding tables.

interface.fix.guidance: Show the focused source diff and the finding it resolves.

interface.generate.guidance: Display a rendered image of the generated surface as the primary outcome; source and decision artifacts are secondary.

interface.plan.guidance: Show the surface map and unit sequence in a reviewable table or diagram.

knowledge.repair.guidance: Show the repaired rule, changed source references and checks as a reviewable table from the repair receipt.

library.update.guidance: Show the mode-specific release or dependency result, with the source change and proof records as secondary evidence.

migration.release.guidance: Show each migration disposition and its release proof, linking logs only as secondary evidence.

quality.verify.guidance: Show the gate result table first, including failures and skipped gates.

release.deploy.guidance: Show the deployed release address or identifier and the probe results that verify it.

runtime.serve.guidance: Show the served URL and head first, followed by runtime checks and the operation receipt.

service.operate.guidance: Show the service's requested and observed states with its probe result.

uat.plan.guidance: Show the flow and case sheet with actors, entry points, accounts, fixtures and isolated namespaces.

uat.verify.guidance: Display the run sheet image first, followed by per-case screenshots and verdict evidence.

workspace.bind.guidance: Show the resolved route, checkout, revision and runtime binding.
